AO/126/2026
The New India Assurance Company Limited --Appellant
 Versus
Rakhi Devi and another --Respondents
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. V.K. Kohli, Senior Advocate, assisted by 
Mr. Kanti Ram Sharma, Advocate for the 
appellant.
Mr. Pankaj Miglani, Advocate for the 
respondent no.2.
The appellant proposes to prefer an appeal 
against the judgment and order dated 
18.12.2025, passed in Employees Compensation
Case No. 01 of 2025, Smt. Rakhi Devi Vs. 
Navyuga Company Limited, Kodiyal, Muni-ki￾Reti, District Tehri Garhwal and another, by the 
Employee Compensation Commissioner/Chief 
Judicial Magistrate, Tehri Garhwal. It is delayed 
by 51 days.
Heard on Delay Condonation Application 
No. 2 of 2025.
Objections have already been filed.
Having heard, this Court is of the view 
that there are good grounds to condoned to 
delay.
Delay Condonation application is allowed. 
Delay in filing the appeal is condoned.
List on 09.10.2026 for hearing on 
admission.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.) 
 01.10.2026
Jitendra
